subject: PenTest follow-up: access findings, closure commitments & evidence request
messages:
From: SecureProbe Inc. <reports@secureprobe.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Corp SecOps <sec-ops@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood Inference - PenTest report (high/med findings) + evidence request

Hi Laura,

Thanks for the opportunity to run the external penetration test against your production-facing services (engagement ID SP-2026-112). Attached is the high-level report (summary attached) and the triaged findings list. We identified a set of findings that we recommend closing prior to Acme moving to a production integration with Redwood:

- F1 (High): OAuth token replay on embedded admin endpoint — allows session reuse for 6 hours if bearer token is leaked.
- F2 (Medium): Incomplete audit logging for cross-account API calls (missing user_id in several event types).
- F3 (Medium): Credentials in a legacy CI job (secrets in a YAML file in a private repo).
- F4 (Low): Overly permissive VPC egress rules in a subnet used for staging.

To validate remediation and provide to Acme for their SIG/SOC review, we need the following evidence from Redwood:
1) For F1: description of the mitigation, updated token TTL or revocation mechanism, and a packet-level capture or server logs showing revocation event (redact PII).
2) For F2: sample audit events showing user_id present (one before remediation, one after), and the logging config snippet (or Loki/GCP Logs link).
3) For F3: proof of rotation (commit/PR ids that removed the secret), and confirmation of secret scanning run results.
4) For F4: screenshot or IaC diff showing the tightened egress rules and the date of change.

Please send the ETA for delivering the artifacts and whether you consider any findings to be out-of-scope based on the engagement rules. We flagged a couple of endpoints as out-of-scope in our report but want confirmation from your side.

Attachments: 20261203-pentest-summary.pdf (report stub)

--
Alicia Moreno
Senior Analyst, SecureProbe Inc.
reports@secureprobe.com

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: SecureProbe Inc. <reports@secureprobe.com>
Cc: Acme Corp SecOps <sec-ops@acme.com>, evelyn_hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 4 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood Inference - PenTest report (high/med findings) + evidence request

Thanks Alicia — appreciate the thorough review and the checklist. Looping in engineering (Vivek) and security/compliance (Evelyn) to coordinate.

Quick responses/plan: 
- We accept F1-F4 as in-scope. No out-of-scope exceptions from our side.
- We will deliver an initial evidence bundle by Friday EOD (2026-12-08) for Acme's review and SecureProbe validation. Final closure artifacts (logs, rotated secrets proof, IaC diffs) targeted for 2026-12-15.

High-level remediation steps we are committing to now: 
1) F1 (OAuth token replay): roll deploy a short-lived token policy + immediate invalidation hook for suspicious reuse; implement stateful token revocation table. ETA: feature branch landed 12/06, canary 12/10, full rollout 12/14.
2) F2 (Audit logging): update event schema to include user_id for cross-account calls, add migration for missing events into the audit-store for 90 days of backfill. ETA: schema PR 12/05, backfill job 12/09-12/12.
3) F3 (Secrets in CI): remove credentials from legacy job, rotate affected keys, add policy to deny plaintext secrets in pipelines. ETA: removal PR 12/05, rotation complete 12/07.
4) F4 (VPC egress): tighten egress via network ACL and add Terraform diff. ETA: change applied 12/06, terraform commit 12/06.

We will include the artifacts you requested. Evelyn, Vivek, can you confirm the dates above and whether the evidence requested (packet capture/logs) is deliverable as described?

Thanks,
Laura
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, SecureProbe Inc. <reports@secureprobe.com>
Cc: evelyn_hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Acme Corp SecOps <sec-ops@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Dec 2026 09:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood Inference - PenTest report (high/med findings) + evidence request

Laura/Alicia — technical update and evidence plan from engineering: 

F1 (OAuth token replay)
- Cause: legacy admin endpoint accepted both session cookie and bearer header; replay was possible when bearer tokens were minted without nonce.
- Fix: issued PR #4382 that adds a short-lived nonce bound to token issuance and a revocation table (service authz.revoke). Deployed to canary cluster 12/10.
- Evidence we will provide: sanitized server logs showing a revoked token event (we will redact IPs), canary deployment timestamps, and the PR diff.

F2 (Audit logging)
- Change: event schema v2 includes user_id and requestor metadata; logging pipeline adjusted to attach user_id for cross-account flows. Migration job created: job id BACKFILL-1226 will backfill 90 days into the audit-store.
- Evidence: example log lines (pre/post), config snippet (loki promtail config), and a link to the backfill job run (Jenkins link).

F3 (Secrets in CI)
- Action: removed legacy job in infra repo (PR #4420), rotated the API keys in Vault, and kicked off a secret-scan (TruffleHog + internal scanner) that returned zero hits for the rotated key.
- Evidence: PR ids, Vault rotation audit entry id, and the secret-scan report (CSV).

F4 (Network egress)
- Action: tightened egress rules for subnet-sub-7 from 0.0.0.0/0 to allowed CIDR list used by partner integrations; Terraform commit TF-1229 pushed 12/06.
- Evidence: Terraform plan diff (attached), and a cloud console screenshot.

Attachments we will drop in the evidence bundle: remediation-checklist-v2.xlsx (mapping findings to artifacts), PR-4382-diff.txt (sanitized), BACKFILL-1226-log-examples.txt, vault-rotation-audit.txt, terraform-eips-diff.txt.

Note on logs: we will avoid sharing PII. Logs will be redacted and a hash of original lines can be provided to prove integrity if SecureProbe/Acme require.

ETA summary (confirming Laura's dates): initial bundle (sanitized artifacts + checklist) 2026-12-08 EOD; full artifacts and backfill completion 2026-12-15.

-Vivek
VP Engineering, Redwood Inference

From: SecureProbe Inc. <reports@secureprobe.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Corp SecOps <sec-ops@acme.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, evelyn_hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 7 Dec 2026 17:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood Inference - PenTest report (high/med findings) + evidence request

Laura / Vivek — thanks for the detailed plan and the PR/job references. That timeline looks reasonable. A few quick asks before we start validating artifacts: 

1) For the revoked-token logs, please include a short note explaining the redaction method and provide checksums (SHA256) of the original unredacted samples so Acme can verify integrity internally.
2) For the backfill job, include an estimate of runtime and any expected service impact during execution (cpu/disk). If the backfill requires a low-traffic window, call this out.
3) For the Vault rotation, please include the Vault audit entry id and the list of principals that were rotated.

If everything arrives on 12/08 in the initial bundle we will triage and aim to send a validation report by 12/11. Final closure confirmation contingent on successful validation of the redacted logs and IaC diffs.

Attachments requested in return: none immediate — we will ACK receipt when bundle posted to the shared Drive link.

Best,
Alicia Moreno
Senior Analyst, SecureProbe Inc.
reports@secureprobe.com
